title: City History Timeline
description: Legal and civic milestones of the city, each cited to civic sources by id (src/data/sources/civic-sources.json). An entry is published only when an official text states it; see docs/civic-data-verification.md. Mirrors HistoryMilestone in src/types/aboutTypes.ts.

slug.description: Stable identifier, unique in the file.

date.description: When it happened, only as precisely as the source states: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD.

instrument.description: The law, decree or order the entry rests on, as cited (e.g. "Republic Act No. 170"). Null when the entry rests on no single instrument.

description.description: What the source states, without interpretation.

sources.description: Civic-source ids of the documents that state this milestone.
